preconditions.description: The number of cards n must be between 2 and 100.
The absolute value of the final card number d must not exceed 10000.
The limit l for the initial integers must be between 1 and 100.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(stdout.split()) == n and all(1 <= int(x) <= l for x in stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: If no valid set exists, output -1; otherwise, output a set of n integers within the range 1 to l.

postconditions.expression: any(all(int(x) - int(y) == d for x, y in zip(stdout.split(), stdout.split()[1:])) for _ in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: The output set must be such that the final card number d can be obtained by repeatedly applying the magic wand operation.
